title: 宝塚記念の後に・燃える

text_block_list.text: Gold City gives it her all in the Takarazuka Kinen, but she is no match for Tamamo Cross.
After the race, Tamamo Cross reveals she had originally been looking forward to facing Gold City, having been inspired by her fiery determination.
But by the time the opportunity came, Gold City had found herself in a slump, leaving Tamamo Cross frustrated to see her rival so affected by public opinion.
Now, however, Gold City's real fighting spirit has returned. When she explains that she runs for the sake of running itself, Tamamo Cross is finally satisfied.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: Looking forward, Gold City seeks a more grueling challenge. She decides to run in the Japan Cup, where the "Beast" Oguri Cap awaits.
